title: Trade Structuring Agent
description: Describe what you think a stock will do in plain English. The agent reads your view, designs three option trades, prices them with Black-Scholes and recommends the best fit.
instructions: Type a market view (for example: I think Apple goes up a bit over the next 3 months, and I don't want to spend much) or click an example, then press Build my trade. Compare the trades in Payoff charts, and open Advanced for greeks and scenarios. The class version uses sample market data.

inference.estimateBasis: Up to two short model requests per trade built. Works without the model using a keyword parser.
